title: From Tariff Changes to Trade Effects: A Practical Framework for Empirical Trade Policy Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.36171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: After decades of trade liberalization, the 2020s mark a profound shift in the globalization narrative, with tariffs once again becoming a central instrument of trade policy. This reversal also challenges how the effects of trade policy are evaluated. Much of the empirical literature has been developed to assess bilateral tariff reductions or elimination and the associated erosion of preferential advantages. Rising multilateral tariffs pose a different question: they alter not only the trade costs faced by directly affected exporters but also the relative market access of all competing suppliers, potentially reinforcing existing preferences. This paper develops a practical framework for translating tariff changes into trade effects in this new policy environment. translated_title: 从关税变化到贸易效应：实证贸易政策分析的实用框架
translated_abstract: 经过数十年的贸易自由化，2020年代标志着全球化叙事的深刻转变，关税再次成为贸易政策的核心工具。这一逆转也对贸易政策效应的评估方式提出了挑战。现有的大量实证文献主要是为了评估双边关税削减或取消以及相关优惠优势的侵蚀而发展起来的。不断上升的多边关税则提出了一个不同的问题：它们不仅改变了直接受影响出口商所面临的贸易成本，还改变了所有竞争供应商的相对市场准入，并可能强化现有的优惠安排。本文开发了一个实用框架，用于在这一新的政策环境中将关税变化转化为贸易效应。我们认为，自由化与保护主义不应被视作对称的政策实验：二者的效应是通过相对市场准入的不同变化来发挥作用的……
tldr: 本文针对多边关税上升的新贸易政策环境，提出了一个将关税变化转化为贸易效应的实用实证分析框架，并强调自由化与保护主义通过相对市场准入的不同变化产生效应，不应被对称对待。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a practical empirical framework for translating tariff changes into trade effects in the new era of rising multilateral tariffs, arguing that liberalization and protectionism operate through different changes in relative market access and should not be treated as symmetric policy experiments.
